newsitem.title: USA: US Home & Garden acquires product line.
newsitem.headline: US Home & Garden acquires product line.

text.p: U.S. Home & Garden Inc on Monday said it acquired the Plasti-Chain line of plastic chain links and decorative edging products from Plastic Molded Concepts Inc for $3.1 million plus payments for inventory and account receivables.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, Plasti-Chain generated revenues of about $3.7 million.
"U.S. Home & Garden has become a category leader in the decorative edging market and these products will enhance our current offering," Robert Kassel, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
